Landstraße (03. Bezirk) — Vienna, Austria

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

No specific violent-crime hotspot or no-go area was identified for Landstraße in current press. A May 2025 meinbezirk.at report on the district's 2024 police statistics found the crime profile dominated by property offences — bicycle theft nearly doubled (479 to 626 cases) and car break-ins almost quadrupled (65 to 289) — alongside a rise in internet fraud (over 900 reports) and shoplifting (about 550 cases). More notably, reported sexual assaults nearly doubled from 23 to 42 cases year-on-year, which the district itself flagged without a specific location pattern. Police stressed these are reported-case counts, not proof of an actual crime increase. Given the documented rise in break-ins and reported assaults, a slightly more cautious night tone is warranted, but nothing in press points to organized street crime, drug scenes, or a defined trouble area within Landstraße. Sources checked: meinbezirk.at, May 2025.
